title: Amazon EKS Reliability Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving EKS clusters remain supported, upgradable and resilient
brief: Standard and extended support windows and their cost, managed add-on compatibility, node provisioning behaviour, upgrade readiness signals and zonal failure handling on EKS specifically.

title: Azure AKS Reliability Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving AKS clusters remain supported, upgradable and resilient
brief: Support policy and long-term support option, automatic upgrade channels and maintenance windows, node image updates, zone configuration and platform-managed change on AKS specifically. Distinct from the EKS page in substance.

title: Terraform Drift Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving infrastructure still matches its Terraform or OpenTofu definition
brief: State versus reality, unmanaged resources, provider and module version lag, plan noise that hides real drift, and reconciliation ownership. Covers Terraform and OpenTofu accurately.

title: Databricks Data Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving data on Databricks remains fresh, correct and governed
brief: Pipeline expectations, catalog lineage and permissions, table maintenance, freshness of tables feeding AI, and compute cost per pipeline. Use current Databricks product names from research.

title: Snowflake Data Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving data on Snowflake remains fresh, correct and recoverable
brief: Data quality metrics, dynamic table lag, recovery windows, access governance and consumption cost per workload. Distinct from the Databricks page in substance. Use current Snowflake product names from research.

title: Kafka Pipeline Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving event streams deliver complete, ordered, timely data
brief: Consumer lag as a freshness signal, schema compatibility enforcement, delivery guarantees in practice, retention versus replay need, and platform version position. Use current Apache Kafka facts from research.

title: vLLM Production Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving self-hosted inference meets throughput, quality and cost thresholds
brief: Self-hosting moves model risk from the vendor to the platform team. Throughput and latency under real load, behaviour after engine or quantisation change, template correctness, GPU utilisation against cost, capacity headroom.

title: RAG Vector Search Assurance
intent: Technology + problem: proving the retrieval layer still returns the right context
brief: Index freshness, embedding model version coupling, recall under approximate search settings, hybrid and reranking configuration, permission filtering and deletion propagation. Vendor-neutral across vector stores.
